title: Hotspawn lobby reverse-engineering — how we get a full list every 4-8 hours

fixture_api.auth: none — public JSON, same array the Hotspawn Angular client hydrates
fixture_api.contract: Unpaginated array of CS2 fixtures with id, participants, scheduled_start_time, lock_time, competition_name, tier, offered_points. If response is not an array, or has duplicate IDs, or is empty, refresh fails closed (scripts/sources.py).

lobby_hydration.how: Parse <script id='ng-state'> JSON. Same fixture array appears under value.u == '/api/v1/fixtures' with s==200. Also contains permalink map.

cs2_lobby.how: Same hydration as lobby, filtered to CS2 picks view. Used as cross-check; must exactly match API IDs when readable.

week_prizes.note: Weekly window Mon 12 Oct 00:00 UTC — Sun 18 Oct 23:59:59.999 UTC (weekId 270, OPEN). Prizes: $400/$200/$100/$50x7 Steam vouchers. Source of tier point math.

rules.note: Lock rule says 5 min; fixture data says 360s (6 min). Published as conflict, per-fixture lock timestamp takes precedence.

cache_behavior.observation: Server-rendered lobby pages are CDN-cached (X-Cache: HIT, Age 4500-5500s, growing ~27s between reads) while fixture API is live (no cache headers). Fixture list in HTML can lag >1h.
cache_behavior.evidence: data/research/1112299f/lobby-probe.json rounds 1-3 plain vs cache-busted ?cb=<epoch> => X-Cache MISS Age 0
cache_behavior.mitigation: Collector requests fresh render (?cb=<epoch>), retries once, names differing IDs and cache state on failure (scripts/sources.py fresh_url).

refresh_cadence.rationale: GitHub drops/delays scheduled runs under load (2026-10-15 only 04:39,13:26,19:53 ran → 8.8h gap). Two offsets ensure a refresh within ~4h; stale bound 8h in scripts/domain.py shows warning.
refresh_cadence.stale_rule: Fresh if observed_at within 8h and not in future; otherwise banner 'Do not treat these as current picks' (data/latest.json stale_after_hours 8).

coverage_guarantee: Every CS2 record returned by scheduled-fixture API, reconciled with both lobby payloads. Future starts separate from past-start anomalies (63 past-start still labeled scheduled, archived). New matches rediscovered on every successful refresh; failures retain last-good snapshot with original timestamps (pages.yml fallback).
prohibited: Hotspawn % picked never enters probability; best-of, lineups, results never inferred; empty or duplicate inventory never accepted as success.
